text:
deploy-bot: Release candidate v4.2.0 -> prod canary triggered. Checking images... ERROR: failed to resolve image digest for gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:v4.2.0 (timeout) :eyes:

kevin: seeing this too, canary stuck at 'image resolution' step.

anna: looks like GCR is returning 429 for digest lookup from our deploy bot. logs:
```
2026-03-20T10:12:34Z deploy-bot: GET https://gcr.io/v2/redwood-inference/runtime/manifests/v4.2.0 -> 429
```

maya: CI also failed on artifact promotion earlier, maybe correlated (remote cache restore hanging).

ryan: timeline — build passed, artifact uploaded, we promoted tag v4.2.0, but deploy-bot always resolves to digest before promote; if digest lookup fails the deploy is paused.

kevin: options: 1) wait it out and retry, 2) try to promote by tag (skip digest check) — risky, 3) rebuild & push new tag to different registry (slow). Thoughts?

anna: don't skip digest check for prod. We had a couple incidents where tag mutability caused drift. Wait + retry for 20m, if still failing, we'll fallback to manual rollout with a pinned digest once we can fetch it.

ci-runner: re-run artifact-publish job? Could try `gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:v4.2.0 --format='get(image_summary.fully_qualified_digest)'` to force manifest fetch.

anna: quick test: ```
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:v4.2.0 --format='get(image_summary.fully_qualified_digest)' || echo 'failed'
```

maya: I'm seeing intermittent 429 from our cloud NAT/egress IP range. Ops — can you check if requests are being rate-limited by GCR or if our CI is thundering herd?

kevin: @ops-team pinged. In the meantime I'm pausing the canary and notifying PMs. @deploy-bot please don't auto-retry more than 3 times (we keep getting queued jobs).

deploy-bot: Canary paused by kevin. Retry count at 2/3. Next retry in 1m.

ryan: ops confirms GCR is rate-limiting our manifest endpoint, recommending backoff. They've opened a support case and suggested staggered retries or use of a GCR mirror in us-central1.

anna: Plan: 1) cancel auto-retries beyond 3, 2) ops to request GCR quota bump / mirror, 3) if unresolved in 30m, abort this cut and schedule small hotfix window with manual promotion. I'll update release notes and rollback instructions.

kevin: ack. tagging release as 'on-hold' in release board.

maya: leaving note for QA: don't run canary tests until deploy resumes.

ci-runner: requeued artifact-publish with 30s backoff; will report if digest resolved.

deploy-bot: Retry failed — still timeout. Manual unblock required.

kevin: OK, rolling into contingency: I'll trigger a manual deploy to staging using the SHA pinned image digest we have in CI artifacts (sha256:abcdef123456). We'll hold prod.

anna: create rollback playbook entry: ```
kubectl set image deployment/api api=gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime@sha256:abcdef123456 --record
```

kevin: thanks. keeping the cut blocked until we confirm GCR resolution. Will update here. :white_check_mark:
